thread:
amy_onboard: Heads up — VitaCare just uploaded a renewed security & data questionnaire. They specifically flagged SOC2 scope, embeddings retention rules in the DPA, and BYOK/KMS key provenance. They want answers by EOD Fri.

maria_cs: Thanks — can you paste the doc link? I'll triage priority.

amy_onboard: https://drive.redwood/vitacare/questionnaire (private link). Main asks: 1) Which components are in-scope for SOC2 logs and backups? 2) Embeddings retention per tenant + purge window. 3) BYOK options and audit trail for keys.

sam_legal: tagging @maria_cs and @devin_eng — legal needs the exact text for DPA addendum. If engineering confirms retention and key control we can draft a short clause. ETA on confirmation?

devin_eng: I'll need to check a couple things: (a) where embeddings are stored (S3 bucket names), (b) whether we have a tenant-level retention flag, and (c) KMS key creation/proof logs. Expect a first pass today.

maria_cs: I'll message the customer to push deadline to Mon if possible. If not, we'll try to meet Fri.

amy_onboard: Customer replied: "Fri is preferable, earlier is great." So we should plan for Fri.

devin_eng: Quick notes — embeddings live in prod S3s with lifecycle set to 90 days by default; per-tenant override exists for Dedicated/private but not for hosted. BYOK: Dedicated/Private supports BYOK; hosted supports CMKs via partner KMS if customer has Dedicated. Audit logs: CloudTrail + KMS key usage logs are available. I'll pull evidence links.

sam_legal: Good. We need a precise sentence for the DPA about retention window + optional customer-controlled BYOK for Dedicated/Private. Drafting now, ping me when evidence links are up.

maria_cs: Action log:
- @devin_eng: paste S3 paths + retention config screenshot (due today 4pm)
- @devin_eng: paste KMS audit export & example key ARN (due today 4pm)
- @sam_legal: draft DPA addendum language (due tonight)
- @amy_onboard: update customer with interim status (ASAP)

devin_eng: copying evidence here:

```
S3 buckets:
- prod-embeddings-01
- prod-embeddings-02
Retention default: 90 days (lifecycle rule)
Per-tenant override: feature flag 'tenant_retention_policy' (enabled for Dedicated)
KMS example key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
CloudTrail: trails/production-trail -> logs at s3://prod-cloudtrail-logs/
```

evidence-bot: Reminder — upload evidence files to /evidence/vitacare/ by 1700 UTC to link in questionnaire.

amy_onboard: Thanks @devin_eng — can you also include a sentence confirming hosted customers cannot BYOK today? I'll forward to legal.

devin_eng: Confirmed — hosted API customers cannot BYOK; only Dedicated/Private. I'll add a note.

sam_legal: Draft ready. Will attach DPA addendum text and reference the evidence. Will send to @maria_cs for QA before we send to customer.

maria_cs: I'll QA and send to customer. If they push back on hosted BYOK, option is to propose Dedicated onboarding or managed KMS solution.

amy_onboard: Closing loop — plan to deliver full packet (answers + evidence links + DPA addendum) by Fri 1500 UTC. If anything slips, call out asap.

maria_cs: 👍 thanks team, will track in the onboarding board and set reminders.
